name: Mandatory Authentication Gate Enforcement
description: Verifies that unauthenticated visitors are blocked from triggering audits and that the authentication modal opens with Supabase OAuth and Magic Link options.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the ShipSafe security cockpit at the root page
Verify that the Sign In Required banner is displayed in the submission panel with GitHub and Google login buttons
Verify that the main audit execution button displays 'Sign in to Run Audit' and remains locked
Click the file dropzone upload area while unauthenticated
Verify that the authentication modal popup immediately appears with 'Sign in to ShipSafe' before any upload occurs
Click the Sign in to Run Audit button in the submission controls
Verify that the authentication dialog is visible with GitHub, Google, and Send Magic Link options
